statement: Let bin(k), for an integer k >= 1, be the unique nonempty byte sequence b of length L over {48 ('0'), 49 ('1')} such that b[0] = 49 and k = sum_{t=0}^{L-1} (b[t]-48) * 2^{L-1-t}; this is the usual binary representation with no leading zeros, encoded in ASCII. A byte sequence p is a contiguous substring of s if there exists an index j with 0 <= j and j + len(p) <= len(s) and p[t] = s[j+t] for every t with 0 <= t < len(p). Then query_string(s,n) returns Result.ok r (it does not fail) and r = true if and only if, for every integer k with 1 <= k <= n, bin(k) is a contiguous substring of s. If this condition fails, r = false.
preconditions: s is a Slice of bytes with 1 <= len(s) <= 1000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49; n is an i64 with 1 <= n <= 10^9.

statement: For every valid s and n, query_string(s,n) does not fail: it returns either Result.ok true or Result.ok false. No arithmetic overflow, index out of bounds, or panic occurs on these inputs.
preconditions: s is a Slice of bytes with 1 <= len(s) <= 1000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49; n is an i64 with 1 <= n <= 10^9.

statement: If n >= 2^{len(s)} (the power computed as an integer), then query_string(s,n) returns Result.ok false.
preconditions: s is a Slice of bytes with 1 <= len(s) <= 1000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49; n is an i64 with 1 <= n <= 10^9.

statement: Using bin(k) for the usual binary representation of k >= 1 as a byte sequence over {'0','1'} with no leading zero, if query_string(s,n) returns Result.ok true, then for every integer k with 1 <= k <= n, len(bin(k)) <= len(s). In particular, len(bin(n)) <= len(s).
preconditions: s is a Slice of bytes with 1 <= len(s) <= 1000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49; n is an i64 with 1 <= n <= 10^9.

statement: When n = 1, query_string(s,1) returns Result.ok true if and only if there exists an index j with 0 <= j < len(s) and s[j] = 49 (the byte '1'); otherwise it returns Result.ok false.
preconditions: s is a Slice of bytes with 1 <= len(s) <= 1000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49; n = 1.

statement: If s contains only the byte 48 ('0'), then for every n with 1 <= n <= 10^9, query_string(s,n) returns Result.ok false.
preconditions: s is a Slice of bytes with 1 <= len(s) <= 1000 and s[i] = 48 for every i with 0 <= i < len(s); n is an i64 with 1 <= n <= 10^9.

statement: If len(s) = 1, then: (a) if s[0] = 49 and n = 1, query_string(s,n) returns Result.ok true; (b) if s[0] = 49 and n > 1, it returns Result.ok false; (c) if s[0] = 48, it returns Result.ok false for every n >= 1.
preconditions: s is a Slice of bytes with 1 <= len(s) <= 1000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49; len(s) = 1; n is an i64 with 1 <= n <= 10^9.

statement: If query_string(s,n1) returns Result.ok true, then query_string(s,n2) returns Result.ok true.
preconditions: s is a Slice of bytes with 1 <= len(s) <= 1000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49; n1 and n2 are integers with 1 <= n2 <= n1 <= 10^9.

statement: If query_string(s,n) returns Result.ok true, then query_string(t,n) returns Result.ok true.
preconditions: s and t are Slice of bytes with 1 <= len(s), len(t) <= 1000 and all their bytes are 48 or 49; s is a contiguous substring of t (there is j with 0 <= j and j+len(s) <= len(t) and s[i]=t[j+i] for all i < len(s)); n is an i64 with 1 <= n <= 10^9.

statement: Using bin(k) for the usual binary representation of k >= 1 as a byte sequence over {'0','1'} with no leading zero, for every integer k with 1 <= k <= n such that len(bin(k)) = len(s), if query_string(s,n) returns Result.ok true, then s = bin(k) byte-for-byte (i.e. len(s)=len(bin(k)) and s[i]=bin(k)[i] for all i < len(s)).
preconditions: s is a Slice of bytes with 1 <= len(s) <= 1000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49; n is an i64 with 1 <= n <= 10^9.

statement: Using bin(k) for the usual binary representation of k >= 1 as a byte sequence over {'0','1'} with no leading zero, if query_string(s,n) returns Result.ok false, then there exists an integer k with 1 <= k <= n such that there is no index j satisfying 0 <= j, j+len(bin(k)) <= len(s), and s[j+t]=bin(k)[t] for all t with 0 <= t < len(bin(k)).
preconditions: s is a Slice of bytes with 1 <= len(s) <= 1000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] = 48 or s[i] = 49; n is an i64 with 1 <= n <= 10^9.
